HSE Officer / Assistant Job at Geo-Lind Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        Incorporated on the 16th of March 2001, Geo-Lind Nigeria Limited is a purpose-built indigenous engineering company providing unmatched services to Nigeria's Oil & Gas, Marine and Production industries. Registered under RC 405771, we operate from our headquarters in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, with corporate and Lagos liaison offices supporting our nationwide reach.

Our core capabilities span Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Calibration & Diagnostics, Instrumentation, Marine (Dry Dock) Services and Logistics Support. Over time, we have assembled a human capital base of highly qualified engineers, technical experts and project managers — backed by strategic partnerships with reputable local and international companies.
     

            
    



From rewinding a 3,500 HP electric motor for SEPNU to revamping medium-voltage machines across NAOC's entire land and swamp areas, our track record speaks with precision. We carry out work that demands expertise, and we consistently deliver it.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: HSE Officer / Assistant

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full Time (Onsite)

About the Role


	We are seeking a competent and safety-conscious HSE Officer / Assistant to support the implementation and monitoring of health, safety, and environmental standards across our operations.
	The ideal candidate will have relevant HSE qualifications, hands on experience in an engineering, fabrication, or construction setting, and the ability to maintain accurate safety records and drive a strong safety culture within the work place.


Key Roles & Responsibilities


	Implement and enforce HSE policies, procedures, and standards across the workplace, workshop, site.
	Conduct routine safety inspections and audits of the work environment, equipment, and process.
	Facilitate Tool Box Talks and safety briefings for staff and site personnel.
	Identify potential hazards and recommend corrective/preventive actions.
	Investigate incidents, accidents, and near-misses; prepare detailed reports and follow up on corrective actions.
	Maintain accurate HSE records, statistics, and documentation/filing systems.
	Ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) by all personnel.
	Coordinate fire safety drills and emergency response procedures. Monitor compliance with occupational health and safety regulations and industry standards.
	Liaise with regulatory bodies and support HSE audits/inspections.


Requirements
Qualifications and Experience:


	HND/B.SC./B.Tech in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety Science, or related field. Minimum HSE Qualifications: HSE 1-3, First Aid, Fire Safety.
	1-2 years of practical experience, preferably in engineering, fabrication, construction, or similar workshop environment.


Required Skills & Competencies:


	Competent in MS Word, Excel, HSE Statistics, Tool Box Talks, and Filing Control.
	Must be a male.


Salary
Very Competitive

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV  to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email

Customer Service Manager Job at Aureole Consulting Limited




        
    

        
        Aureole Consulting Limited is a Pan-African HR consulting company that specializes in Talent Acquisition, Human Resource Business Partner, HRIS Referral, CV, Cover letter & LinkedIn Optimization, Social Media Job Advertisement, amongst other services.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Customer Service Manager

Job Location: Lekki Ajah, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Customer Service Manager will lead and manage the day-to-day operations of the Customer Services Department, ensuring the delivery of consistently high-quality service to internal and external customers by implementing the customer service strategy, managing customer enquiries and order processing, monitoring service performance, and driving continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities


	Lead and manage the day-to-day operations of the Customer Services Department.
	Implement the company’s Customer Service strategy and ensure alignment with departmental and business objectives.
	Oversee the accurate and timely processing of customer quotations, orders, and order confirmations.
	Manage staffing, training, coaching, and performance to ensure the team delivers efficient and exceptional customer service.
	Establish and monitor service standards, performance targets, and KPIs.
	Drive continuous improvement initiatives across customer enquiries and order processing.
	Promote effective communication and collaboration across the Customer Services function.
	Foster a positive, motivated, and high-performing team environment.
	Support change management and process improvement initiatives to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of recent and proven experience in a B2B or B2C customer service environment, including at least 3 years in a senior customer service or customer relations management role.
	Experience gained within a manufacturing or wholesale environment is an advantage.
	Proven experience in a quick response, high fluctuating, customer driven industry.
	Demonstrated experience in change management, process improvement, or continuous improvement initiatives.
	Strong experience in resource planning, organizing, team management, problem-solving and performance management.
	Strong customer focus with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office packages and CRM/customer service platforms such as Zendesk, Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, Gorgias, or similar systems.
	Experience handling customer enquiries through email, live chat, WhatsApp, telephone, and social media.
	Preferably male candidates (for gender balance).
	Proximity to Lekki is Imperative.


Salary
N350,000 – N450,000 Monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using ''Customer Service Manager'' as the subject of the mail.

Medical Laboratory Scientist Job at ExCare Health




        
    

        
        ExCare is a leading primary healthcare provider committed to connecting stakeholders and providing easy access to primary healthcare. What started as a retail pharmacy has evolved into a multi-faceted healthcare hub, integrating pharmacy, diagnostics, and immunization services to deliver a seamless experience for our customers. 

With 5 retail pharmacies, 2 laboratories, and an NPHCDA-approved immunization center, we are redefining community healthcare through innovation, convenience, and excellence.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Medical Laboratory Scientist

Job Location: Chevron, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a qualified Medical Laboratory Scientist to conduct accurate clinical laboratory testing, support patient diagnosis and treatment, and maintain high standards of laboratory quality and safety.


Key Responsibilities


	Perform routine and specialized laboratory tests on blood, tissues, and body fluids using standard procedures
	Operate, calibrate, and maintain laboratory equipment while monitoring quality control measures
	Ensure proper specimen handling, documentation, and reporting of test results
	Maintain a sterile laboratory environment and comply with safety, quality, and regulatory standards
	Support blood grouping, compatibility testing, and identification of infectious agents
	Manage laboratory inventory, prepare routine reports, and maintain confidentiality of patient information.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Medical Laboratory Science (BMLS)
	Must have completed NYSC
	Registration and a valid practicing license with the Medical Laboratory Science Council of Nigeria
	Minimum of one year of experience in a similar role.
	Strong documentation, quality management, and laboratory data management skills
	Attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to work effectively in a team.


Salary
N240,000 - N300,000 / month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
